about.main_title: Your notes, your data, your system.
about.subtitle: xelanote is a fast, self-hosted note-taking app designed for networked thinking.
about.feature_backlinks_description: See at a glance which notes refer to the current one.
about.feature_graph_description: Visualize the connections between your notes as an interactive knowledge graph.
about.feature_fulltextsearch_description: Instantly find what you're looking for across all your notes.
about.feature_markdowneditor_description: Format your notes with a fast Markdown editor, including color syntax and image resizing.
about.feature_versionhistory_description: Track every change and restore previous versions of your notes at any time.
about.feature_offline_description: Create and edit notes without internet. Changes sync automatically when you're back online.
about.feature_ai_description: Summarize, translate, rephrase or expand your text with built-in AI assistance.
about.feature_organization_description: Organize your notes with a flexible folder tree and tags with drag & drop support.
about.e2e_description: Your notes are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before they reach the server.
about.zero_knowledge_description: Your password and keys never leave your device.
about.twofa_description: Protect your account with TOTP-based 2FA and backup codes.
about.open_source_description: All code is available on GitHub and can be audited.
about.platform_selfhosted_description: Maintain full control over your data on your own server with Docker.
about.platform_desktop_description: Native desktop experience for Linux with secure token storage.
about.platform_themes_description: From Rosé Pine to Tokyo Night — choose the look that fits you best.
about.platform_i18n_description: Available in English and German with full interface localization.

encryption.title: Encryption Settings
encryption.subtitle: Manage your end-to-end encryption and privacy settings
encryption.status_active_description: Your notes are end-to-end encrypted. The key is available in your current session.
encryption.status_locked_description: Log in to activate encryption and access encrypted notes.
encryption.title_encryption_description: Also protect the titles of your notes. When enabled, titles are no longer searchable.
encryption.title_encryption_info: Note: With title encryption enabled, you can only search by folders and keywords (if enabled).
encryption.keyword_description: Enables full-text search by extracting common words from your notes.
encryption.keyword_warning_text: Extracting keywords means that common words from your notes are stored unencrypted. This can reveal sensitive information such as names, places, or topics.
encryption.keyword_warning_example: Example: A note about "Bitcoin Investment Strategy" would store the keywords "bitcoin", "investment", "strategy" in plain text.
encryption.keyword_warning_final: Only enable if you need search and accept the data leak risk!
encryption.visible_keywords: Keywords (if opt-in enabled) - common words from notes
encryption.recommendation_titles: Enable "Encrypt titles" for complete metadata protection
encryption.recommendation_keywords: Disable "Extract keywords" (no search, but no leak)
encryption.recommendation_folders: Use generic folder names (e.g. "Notes" instead of "Doctor Appointments")
encryption.recommendation_recovery: Download recovery token and store it securely
encryption.password_loss_text: If you forget your password, encrypted notes are IRRETRIEVABLY lost! Only the recovery token can restore your notes. Make sure to store it securely.
encryption.modal_title_encryption_item2: Title search will no longer work
encryption.modal_title_encryption_item3: You will need to rely on folders and keywords (if enabled)
encryption.modal_title_encryption_note: This provides maximum privacy, but reduces search functionality.
encryption.modal_keyword_warning: Extracting keywords means that common words from your notes are stored unencrypted. This can reveal sensitive information such as names, places, or topics.
encryption.modal_keyword_example: Example: A note about "Bitcoin Investment Strategy" would store the keywords "bitcoin", "investment", "strategy" in plain text.
encryption.modal_keyword_final_warning: Only enable if you need search in encrypted notes and accept the data leak risk!
